01

The Strategic Discovery Call

We don't just ask what tasks you need done; we analyze your business bottlenecks. We discuss your pain points, company culture, and the precise technical skills required for the role.

02

Custom Talent Matching

We dive into our extensive talent pool to find the perfect candidate. We don't send you a stack of resumes to sift through; we hand-pick the top 1-2 candidates who align perfectly with your requirements.

03

Meet, Greet, & Approve

You will interview your shortlisted, pre-vetted assistant via video call. This ensures a perfect personality and communication fit before you ever make a commitment.

04

Onboard & Scale Safely

Begin delegating with confidence. Your dedicated Client Success Manager will stay involved during the initial weeks to ensure a smooth transition, establish KPIs, and guarantee ongoing excellence.
